name: Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler
summary: At Dreadmist Peak, a filled sampler holds water gathered by Horde druids from the summit pools. The Cenarion Circle studies the sample to learn what is poisoning wildlife in the northern Barrens.

sections.title: A Tainted Source
sections.body: Dreadmist Peak’s high crags hold pools whose mists shape weather and rainfall across the northern Barrens. The Burning Blade, who worship demons, made their coven atop the summit, and the water soon soured. Cenarion druids suspect demonic rites poisoned the vapors that feed the surrounding savanna. They send initiates to collect a sample in a special sampler. The foul liquid confirms their fears: its corruption can sicken the herds below.

sections.title: Curing the Savanna
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Tonga Runetotem uses the sample to help find an antidote. The Burning Blade are suspected of tainting the water, and its properties help the Cenarion Circle understand the poison. By studying the taint in the vial, druids make herbal remedies for dying gazelles and learn to wield their own natural power over poison.

faq.q: Where is this water sample obtained?
aliases: where do i get the sample
faq.answer: The sample comes from a pool at Dreadmist Peak’s summit, northwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the water on Dreadmist Peak tainted?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade cult has taken over Dreadmist Peak’s heights to worship demons. Dendrite Starblaze suspects the cult tainted the summit’s natural waters.

aliases: who do i bring the sampler to
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem needs the filled sampler. He is a Cenarion druid at the Crossroads, investigating the sudden sickness among wildlife in the Barrens.

faq.q: How does this poisoned water affect the Barrens?
faq.answer: Dreadmist Peak’s airy heights and pools influence local weather and mist. Once poisoned, the vapors settle over the savanna north of the main road and make the native gazelles sick.

faq.q: What is the sampler used for after it is collected?
aliases: what does tonga do with it
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem studies the foul liquid to learn the nature of its demonic taint, then uses that knowledge to make a curative salve for druids to treat afflicted gazelles.

angles.text: As a Horde druid, you gather this sample as a rite of passage. It teaches you how corruption spreads through natural waterways and prepares you to master curative magic.
As a member of the Horde, you can see the Burning Blade cult’s threat growing within Horde territory in the Barrens.
